description: Read one of your tasks (platform.task@1: state, result, cost, explanation) with GET /api/v1/tasks/:id, and watch it live with GET /api/v1/tasks/:id/events: text/event-stream of actor.task-event@2 (state changes, the agent's steps, the files and charts a tool made, the end), resumable with Last-Event-ID. A file or chart the task made is opened with GET /api/v1/tasks/:id/artifacts/:mediaId, which answers a redirect to a fresh signed OpenVibe.Media URL: the object is private to the task's requester. Only the task's requester (or its project's tokens) can read it.
